summary.headline: Astrological Questions on War and Weather
summary.text: Catalog entries 77–97 of an Angelican astrological codex, covering interposition, obeying and equipollent signs, declination, weather, waters and rains, rumors, regional affinities, the twelve places, lots or terms, lawsuits, war, siege, military lots, and Mars’s directional positions. Cross-references cite Venetian codex 5 and Viennese codices 2 and 4.
